# OctoFlow CLI Command Reference

This document is automatically generated from the registered Typer command tree in `octoflow/cli.py`.

OctoFlow exposes three CLI entrypoint aliases with identical semantics:
- `octoflow <command>`: Canonical command invocation.
- `octo <command>`: Short alias.
- `octos <command>`: Multi-agent plural alias.

### <a id="octoflow-bench"></a>`octoflow bench`

Run standardized 8-arm algorithmic & architectural challenge benchmarks. \[experimental]

**Usage:**
```bash
octoflow bench [OPTIONS]
```

#### Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--task`, `-t` | `str` | `all` | Challenge task ID ('all' or specific: rate_limiter, lru_cache, jwt_validator, dag_topo_sort) |
| `--mode`, `-m` | `str` | `both` | Gate mode: gated, ungated, or both |
| `--provider`, `-p` | `str` | `mock` | LLM provider name: mock, fake, anthropic, openai, gemini, ollama, etc. |
| `--fake` | `bool` | `false` | Shortcut to run benchmarks using the deterministic Fake/Replay provider |
| `--model` | `str` | `None` | Model identifier (optional, uses provider default if omitted) |
| `--runs`, `-n` | `int` | `3` | Number of benchmark repetitions per task and mode (default: 3) |
| `--seed`, `-s` | `int` | `42` | Base pseudo-random seed (default: 42) |
| `--out`, `-o` | `str` | `benchmarks/results` | Output directory for run JSONs and summary.md |
| `--record-cassette` | `str` | `None` | Directory to record LLM request/response cassettes |

### <a id="octoflow-config"></a>`octoflow config`

Inspect, validate, and update OctoFlow typed configuration settings.

**Usage:**
```bash
octoflow config [OPTIONS]
```

#### Subcommands

| Subcommand | Syntax | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `migrate` | `octoflow config migrate` | Migrate configuration to latest schema or restore from backup. |
| `path` | `octoflow config path` | Display the filesystem path of the configuration file. |
| `set` | `octoflow config set` | Set a single configuration key value, validate, and write atomically. |
| `show` | `octoflow config show` | Display current active configuration settings with masked secrets. |
| `validate` | `octoflow config validate` | Validate current configuration file against Pydantic schema. |

### <a id="octoflow-consortium"></a>`octoflow consortium`

Deploy the multi-cephalopod consortium (3 to 8 octopuses • 24 to 64 arms) on a project.

**Usage:**
```bash
octoflow consortium [OPTIONS]
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `objective` | `str` | Yes | `None` | Engineering goal for the multi-octopus consortium |

#### Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--octos`, `-o` | `str` | `auto` | Count of octopuses ('auto', 3 for Triad, 8 for Octopolis) |
| `--model` | `str` | `mock` | LLM backend: 'mock', 'anthropic', 'openai', 'ollama' |
| `--budget`, `-b` | `float` | `10.0` | Max cost dollars |
| `--dir`, `-d` | `str` | `.` | Target project workspace folder |
| `--port`, `-p` | `int` | `8088` | 3D Visualizer port |
| `--host` | `str` | `127.0.0.1` | Telemetry server bind host (default: 127.0.0.1) |
| `--ui` | `bool` | `false` | Auto-open 3D Visualizer in browser |
| `--theme`, `-t` | `str` | `None` | Theme palette |
| `--dry-run` | `bool` | `false` | Run with mock provider, write no project files |
| `--plain` | `bool` | `false` | Force plain line-oriented output (no Live TUI dashboard) |
| `--quiet`, `-q` | `bool` | `false` | Suppress progress telemetry lines |
| `--json` | `bool` | `false` | Output final outcome as machine-readable JSON |
| `--no-color` | `bool` | `false` | Disable ANSI color codes (respects NO_COLOR standard) |
| `--no-anim` | `bool` | `false` | Disable animations and continuous refresh |
| `--ascii` | `bool` | `false` | Force plain ASCII-only characters (< 128) |
| `--legacy-glyphs` | `bool` | `false` | Use legacy Unicode glyphs |

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--speed`, `-s` | `float` | `1.0` | Replay playback speed multiplier (0 = instantaneous playback) |
| `--no-visualizer` | `bool` | `false` | Disable broadcasting replayed telemetry to 3D visualizer |
| `--port`, `-p` | `int` | `8088` | Visualizer telemetry port to broadcast on |

### <a id="octoflow-run"></a>`octoflow run`

Deploy the cephalopod swarm (1 to 8 octopuses • 8 to 64 arms) to execute an objective.

**Usage:**
```bash
octoflow run [OPTIONS]
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `objective` | `str` | Yes | `None` | High-level engineering or research goal for the swarm |

#### Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--mode`, `-m` | `str` | `software_dev` | Swarm mode: 'software_dev', 'aiml_research', 'fullstack_ai' |
| `--guild`, `-g` | `str` | `None` | Specialist roster/guild name from ~/.octoflow/guilds/ |
| `--model` | `str` | `mock` | LLM backend: 'mock', 'anthropic', 'openai', 'ollama' |
| `--budget`, `-b` | `float` | `5.0` | Hard spending limit in dollars |
| `--dir`, `-d` | `str` | `.` | Target project workspace folder |
| `--port`, `-p` | `int` | `8088` | 3D Visualizer telemetry port |
| `--host` | `str` | `127.0.0.1` | Telemetry server bind host (default: 127.0.0.1) |
| `--open-ui`, `--ui` | `bool` | `false` | Auto-open 3D Connectome Visualizer in default browser |
| `--octos`, `-o` | `str` | `1` | Count of octopuses: 'auto' (dynamic load autoscaler), 1 (Solo), 3 (Triad), or 8 (Octopolis) |
| `--theme`, `-t` | `str` | `None` | Theme palette ('abyssal', 'catppuccin', 'tokyo-night', 'dracula', 'cyberpunk', 'nord', 'gruvbox', 'minimalist') |
| `--sandbox`, `-s` | `str` | `local` | Execution isolation: 'local' (host) or 'docker' (containerized) |
| `--dry-run` | `bool` | `false` | Run with mock provider, write no project files |
| `--allow-dirty` | `bool` | `false` | Allow running in a git repo with uncommitted changes (snapshots changes via git stash create) |
| `--init-git` | `bool` | `false` | Automatically initialize git repository if workspace is not in a git repo |
| `--no-checkpoint` | `bool` | `false` | Disable git checkpointing and branch creation |
| `--open` | `bool` | `false` | Open primary service URL in browser after ignition readiness |
| `--max-tokens` | `int` | `None` | Maximum tokens allowed across run |
| `--max-calls` | `int` | `None` | Maximum LLM calls allowed across run |
| `--timeout` | `int` | `None` | Maximum wall time in seconds |
| `--max-heal` | `int` | `None` | Maximum healing iterations |
| `--no-limits` | `bool` | `false` | Disable all execution budget limits |
| `--plain` | `bool` | `false` | Force plain line-oriented output (no Live TUI dashboard) |
| `--quiet`, `-q` | `bool` | `false` | Suppress progress telemetry lines |
| `--json` | `bool` | `false` | Output final outcome as machine-readable JSON |
| `--no-color` | `bool` | `false` | Disable ANSI color codes (respects NO_COLOR standard) |
| `--no-anim` | `bool` | `false` | Disable animations and continuous refresh |
| `--ascii` | `bool` | `false` | Force plain ASCII-only characters (< 128) |
| `--legacy-glyphs` | `bool` | `false` | Use legacy Unicode glyphs (lightning bolt, heavy check) |
| `--trace` | `bool` | `false` | Write detailed JSONL execution trace under ~/.octoflow/runs/<id>/trace.jsonl (0600) |
| `--trace-prompts` | `bool` | `false` | Include redacted prompts/responses in trace (requires --trace) |
